inputs.original_text: Workers employed in the support programmes of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth staged a protest outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday and announced a 24-hour strike, calling for legally binding job security guarantees — even as the government argued it had already delivered on the most significant demands. inputs.modified_text: These workers tied to the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth are now protesting outside the Presidential Palace and pushing a 24-hour strike for ironclad, legally binding job security. This comes after the government already met their most significant demands, yet they're still refusing to accept responsibility and disrupting the order that keeps our education system running for families. Such actions show a troubling sense of entitlement over the authority and stability our traditions depend on, rather than focusing on personal accountability that would better serve the nation.
